intro: North Macedonia's biggest sporting successes have come in handball and football.

chapters.title: Handball
text: Skopje club Vardar won the European handball Champions League in 2017 and 2019, and Kiril Lazarov is one of the top scorers in handball history.

chapters.title: Football
text: North Macedonia reached its first major tournament at Euro 2020, captained by Goran Pandev.

keyTerms.meaning: The top competition for club teams in Europe.
